errors.title: The data could not be loaded
errors.unknownCode: The server answered with an error ({code}).
errors.unknownCodeRequest: The server answered with an error ({code}, request {request}).
errors.notFoundText: The address does not match any section of the dashboard.
errors.serverTitle: The page could not be loaded
errors.serverText: The dashboard server failed while preparing this page. Check its console.
errors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot connect to the documentation database. Check DATABASE_URL in apps/dashboard/.env and that its server answers.
errors.SCHEMA_MISSING: The database does not have the documentation tables. Run pnpm -F meeko-site run db:migrate.
errors.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: That source does not exist. An import may have changed its id.
errors.SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND: That snapshot no longer exists: the snapshot retention deleted it.
errors.SNAPSHOT_EMPTY: That snapshot has no pages and cannot be activated.
errors.JOB_RUNNING: An import or a publication is running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.INVALID_ORIGIN: The server refused the request because of its origin. Open the dashboard from its usual address.
errors.INVALID_CSRF: The session changed in another tab. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: The session ended (it expired, closed after inactivity or was closed in another tab). Reload the page to sign in again.
errors.SESSION_REVOKED: The session was closed. Reload the page to sign in again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The data sent is not valid.
errors.REVISION_NOT_FOUND: That revision does not exist or does not belong to this source.
errors.SOURCE_NOT_EDITABLE: This source cannot be edited from the dashboard.
errors.INVALID_REVISION: Not saved: the Markdown is not valid for this source.
errors.REVISION_NOT_DRAFT: Only drafts can change: published and archived revisions are history. Create a new draft from it.
errors.DRAFT_CHANGED: Someone saved this draft while you were editing it. Nothing was overwritten: copy your changes, reload and apply them again.
errors.REVISION_REJECTED: Not published: the site would reject this revision. The previous published revision is untouched.
errors.MERGE_NOT_TRIVIAL: The merge is not trivial: Git and the revision changed the same lines. Resolve it by hand in a new draft.
errors.NO_CONFLICT: This revision already starts from the current Git: there is nothing to merge.
errors.PREVIEW_TIMEOUT: The preview took too long and was stopped. Try again.
errors.BODY_TOO_LARGE: The Markdown is too large to send (Meeko's limit is 1 MiB per request).
errors.TOO_LARGE: The Markdown is over the size limit of a revision.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The dashboard server does not answer.
errors.INVALID_MODERATION: Not saved: the rule or the announcement is not valid.
errors.UNKNOWN_PAGE: That web does not have that page. Import the sources or publish a snapshot if it is new.
errors.MODERATION_NOT_FOUND: That rule or announcement no longer exists: someone else deleted it. The list already shows what is there now.
errors.MODERATION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this rule or announcement since you loaded the list. Nothing was saved: the list already shows their version. Review it; saving again will replace that change.
errors.INVALID_RANGE: The date range is not valid: the start must come before the end and span one year at most.
errors.FEEDBACK_NOT_FOUND: That comment no longer exists: someone else deleted it. Reload the list.
errors.TRANSLATION_NOT_FOUND: That page has no translation to compare: it is not a guide or a written reference page of the site.
errors.UNKNOWN: An unexpected error happened. Check the server console.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: The data sent is not valid.

validation.markdownTooLarge: The Markdown is over 900 kB once encoded.
validation.rangeReversed: The start date is after the end date.
validation.rangeTooLong: The range spans 366 days at most.
validation.choosePage: Choose a page of the web.
validation.ruleVersion: A rule that changes carries the id and the version that were read.
validation.endAfterStart: The end must come after the start.
validation.announcementVersion: An announcement that changes carries the version that was read.

stateHelp.git: No published revision: the web shows the file in Git.
stateHelp.edited: The published revision differs from Git, and Git has not changed since it was written.
stateHelp.conflict: The published revision differs and Git changed after it was written.
stateHelp.missing: The file no longer exists in Git.

translationHelp.translated: The translation starts from the original that Git has now.
translationHelp.outdated: The original changed after it was translated: those changes still have to be carried over.
translationHelp.missing: No translation: the English web shows the Spanish original with the “not translated” notice.

badge.noMarkdownHelp: .meeko pages do not keep their text in the database: they are edited in the repository.
badge.importStaleHelp: Git changed since the last import: import the sources again.

summary.import: {inserted} new, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged, {removed} removed and {restored} restored.
summary.publish: Snapshot {id} published and active with {pages} pages: {es} in Spanish and {en} in English ({translated} translated, {outdated} outdated and {missing} not translated).
summary.publishRevisions: Snapshot {id} published and active with {pages} pages, {revisions} with published revisions: {es} in Spanish and {en} in English ({translated} translated, {outdated} outdated and {missing} not translated).
summary.health: {pending} pending references, {exports} exports without a page and {broken} broken links out of {links} links.
summary.conflict: Conflict: the active snapshot changed from {from} to {to} while rendering. Nothing was stored; publish again.
summary.reactivated: Conflict: snapshot {from} was activated again while rendering. Nothing was stored; publish again.
summary.failed: The job failed without a result: check its output.

issues.meekoPage: .meeko pages are edited in the repository.
issues.gitMissing: Git no longer has this file.
issues.previewOnly: Only the guides and the reference of the site have a preview.
issues.notTranslation: Only a translation whose original was imported can be marked as translated.
